An Apologetic defense of Creation : Students were assigned the following prompt: How would you defend Creation to an Evolutionist? Students were given two Christian websites to use: Answers in Genesis and Biologos. Students were encouraged to use their textbook and Bible to incorporate evidence into their paper. The research could be given in an informative paper or in a story format like they were speaking to a friend. Requirement of at least 700 words, proper grammar and punctuation, and must be able to explain at least one piece of evidence for intelligent design.

Test 5- Biology : Students were tested on their understanding of Biology-the study of the origin of life. In Bible, we study Biology as it relates to our worldview: Do we believe we were made in God's image, or do we believe we evolved? Closed book test.
